crossRefs.note: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of…
For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in…
How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
“How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
“How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

translations.web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
translations.bsb: Surely all of you have seen it for yourselves. Why then do you keep up this empty talk?
translations.kjv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
translations.asv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?
